ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; the visible fluke surface is composed of >90% low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white/light-tan) pixels localized to distal barnacle clusters and water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark contiguous region across both lobes. A high-contrast cluster of light-colored geometric shapes is localized at the distal tip of the right lobe (approximate coordinates 90% width, 20% height relative to fluke bounding box).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with an estimated angle of 42 degrees and a depth of approximately 50 pixels from the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels along the entire visible trailing edge; serrations are most jagged on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a downward-tapered convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of approximately 12-18 roughly circular, high-contrast white and tan pixel groups (barnacles) on the distal tip of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) attached to the trailing edge and distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, secondary U-shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from standard serrations, located approximately mid-way between the median notch and the tip.
